body.p: , after made parts files of their own.

item.p: src/function_library_regex.c holds every function of F&O 4.0, section 6.3: fn:matches, fn:replace and fn:tokenize move there from the string part (removal only; no wave-0 packet owned that file), plus fn:analyze-string, fn:matching-segments and fn:regex. Named groups reach results: $<name> in replacement strings (FORX0004 when no group has the name), name keys in the groups maps of fn:replace and fn:matching-segments, name attributes in fn:analyze-string.

fn:analyze-string builds a parentless untyped element in an arena tree, as fn:json-to-xml does; fn:group elements nest by range and by the regex's own nesting of parentheses (new sxml_regex_group_parent, so (b)(x?) and (b(x?)) differ, QT4 analyzeString-017/-017a); lookahead groups follow as fn:lookahead-group.

fn:regex returns a map (no static context knows the named record types yet, so fn:compiled-regex-record assert-types fail) whose functions are anonymous function items of hidden rows capturing pattern and flags; their signatures reuse the resolved parameter types of fn:matches#3 and fn:replace#4 from the evaluation's function table. Each call compiles again (no cache).

tests/function_library_test.c (owned by 2.17 later, by nobody now) names the regex part in its fixture so its regex cases keep running; new cases and an allocation-failure loop over the new functions.
